description_en: Detaches domain names from a paid Alibaba Cloud DNS instance
description_zh: 根据实例ID解绑付费版DNS的域名
kebab_example: aliyun alidns unbind-instance-domains --lang en --domain-names example.com,example.net --instance-id dns-cn-9lb38ldq900 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnbindInstanceDomains

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese

- **en**: English
parameters.help_zh:
设置请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为**zh**。取值：

- **zh**：中文
- **en**：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The list of domain names.

Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 100 domain names.<props="intl"> For more information, see [DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains).</props>
parameters.help_zh:
域名列表。

使用英文“ , ”号隔开多个域名，最多100个域名。<props="china">域名名称可通过调用[DescribeDomains](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
<props="intl">域名名称可通过调用[DescribeDomains](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
parameters.name: domain_names

parameters.help_en: The ID of the authoritative domain name instance.<props="intl"> For more information, see [ListCloudGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances).</props>
parameters.help_zh:
权威域名产品实例ID。<props="china">可通过调用[ListCloudGtmInstances](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
<props="intl">可通过调用[ListCloudGtmInstances](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-listcloudgtminstances?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
parameters.name: instance_id
